description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Solutions Consultant - Senior Principal, NA ENT

Why We Have This Role

Our pre-sales team helps some of the largest organizations in the world find and close experience gaps with the Qualtrics XM Data & AI Platform, which combines experience management (XM) data with artificial intelligence (AI) to predict what comes next and act on it.

As a Solutions Consultant in our Financial Services and Insurance (FSI) business, you will partner with Sales Teams on opportunities across banking, insurance, wealth and asset management, and payments. You bring the product skills to show what the platform can do and the strategic perspective to help business leaders decide what to do with it. In an industry shaped by regulation, rising customer expectations, digital disruption and retention pressure, you will connect XM and AI to outcomes FSI leaders care about, such as customer loyalty, advisor and agent effectiveness, claims and servicing quality, and operational risk.

While most of your efforts will be focused in the pre-sales environment, some additional cross-functional initiatives may include input in product direction, content generation, contributing to analyst reports/relationships and attending marketing events.

You will report to a Solution Consulting Manager.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Earning trust with Account Executives as their go-to partner on deal strategy and execution in FSI accounts.
  • Becoming a trusted advisor to customer business and technology leaders, helping them build their XM vision and a roadmap toward the art of the possible.
  • Building and delivering compelling product demonstrations that show the value of Qualtrics in the context of FSI use cases and workflows.
  • Winning the technical decision and the business case on enterprise deals with multiple stakeholders.
  • Contributing to team outcomes, including win rate, pipeline, net new annual recurring revenue (ARR) and customer satisfaction.
  • Sharing what works and helping your peers grow.

How You’ll Grow

  • Learn the full XM platform, including customer experience, employee experience and market research, and the AI capabilities that connect them.
  • Build deep FSI expertise across banking, insurance, wealth management and payments, including the regulatory, security and data considerations that shape buying decisions.
  • Deepen your expertise in AI and data and shape how FSI customers apply them to business outcomes.
  • Build influence with Product and Marketing by bringing field insight into product direction and go-to-market strategy.
  • Grow your career through a structured promotion process, career action planning with your manager, and internal mobility (Qmobility).
  • As we build an AI-first company and change the market for Experience Management, you will be at the cutting edge of this transformation in enterprise software.

Things You’ll Do

  •     
  • Partner with account executives on deal strategy and account planning for FSI opportunities.
  • Contribute to discovery by owning technical discovery, uncovering business challenges and tying them to measurable outcomes.
  • Design, build and deliver tailored use case solutions and demonstrations, including FSI scenarios such as digital banking journeys, contact center and voice of the customer programs, claims and policy experiences, advisor and agent feedback, and employee engagement.
  • Build business cases and value stories that translate product capabilities into value drivers for FSI buyers, connecting XM and AI to revenue, cost and risk.
  • Facilitate executive briefings and workshops that help customers shape their XM vision and roadmap.
  • Advise customers on XM program design and governance, including use-case prioritization, data sources, closed-loop action, a phased maturity roadmap, program ownership, operating model and regulatory considerations specific to financial services.
  • Answer technical questions on architecture, integrations, APIs, security, privacy and data, including the questions FSI security and compliance teams ask.
  • Position Qualtrics against competitors on both product strengths and business value.
  • Support expansion with existing FSI customers by identifying new use cases across business lines and XM areas, including customer, employee and market research.
  • Share customer and field feedback with Product Management, Marketing and Engineering, contribute to content, events and enablement, and stay current on FSI industry trends, regulation and competitor moves.

Required Qualifications

  •    
  • 5 or more years in pre-sales, solutions engineering, solution architecture, consulting or another customer-facing technical or strategic role at a business-to-business (B2B) software as a service (SaaS) company, or as a practitioner leading customer, employee or research programs.
  • Experience supporting sales cycles both strategically and technically with director, vice president and C-level buyers.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the drive to configure, build and deliver software demonstrations tailored to a customer's needs.
  • Ability to explain and resolve common technical aspects of SaaS software, including security, API protocols and integrations, and SLAs.
  • Experience building a business case or value story that ties a solution to measurable outcomes.
  • Working understanding of AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication, including presenting to executives.
  • Ability to explain industry trends and complex concepts, including regulatory and market shifts in financial services, clearly to business audiences who are not subject matter experts.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the initiative to pivot as needs change.
  • Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, psychology, computer science, information systems, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to or working with financial services or insurance organizations, such as banks, credit unions, insurers, wealth and asset managers, or payments companies.
  • Familiarity with FSI regulatory, security and data privacy expectations and how they affect software buying decisions.
  • Experience with Customer or Employee Experience software or programs, including contact centers and voice of the customer.
  • Experience consulting on the design and implementation of Employee or Customer Experience Management (XM) programs, or working with enterprise CX, EX or research teams at large organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with AI and large language models in a customer-facing setting, including using AI tools to improve how you sell and go to market.
  • Knowledge of survey design, change management, or quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
  • Experience reading and debugging HTML, CSS, JavaScript or SQL, with the support of AI tools

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We play a critical role in the commercial engine, driving innovation and market penetration through direct work with customer decision makers and scaling our expertise across the field.
  • Our team values initiative and independence. Everyone is encouraged to think ahead, anticipate potential issues and solve them proactively.
  • We are known for our collaborative spirit, a strong desire to learn and, most importantly, a commitment to our customers’ success. We help Sales and Qualtrics hit their targets by building customer confidence and demonstrating the value of our technology. We are comfortable in a fast-changing environment, and creativity is often our best tool.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Pension plan match
  • We offer private dental and health insurance
  • Wellness reimbursement - up to the value of $300 per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
 
​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act
